notes.title: "Dice Player One" officially launched!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
 
We’re excited to announce that the full release of [b] Dice Players is now available on Steam! You can buy and start playing right now![/b]
 
In this official release, we’ve prepared the following features for you:
[olist] 
[*] Over 300 unique dice, each with its own fun and interesting abilities. 
[*] 20 distinct dice sets, each with different starting abilities. 
[*] 30 bosses, each with its own BGM, custom game board, and exclusive boss reward dice! 
[*] A unique rhythm points system that allows you to tweak the game’s difficulty and collect Rhythm Points. Hit certain point milestones to unlock up to 50 exclusive dice!
[*] 10 challenging levels, each offering different gameplay mechanics. Try to complete them all! 
[*] Daily challenges with leaderboards, allowing you to compete with players from around the world! 
[*] And there’s much more to discover—buy it now and dive in! 
[/olist] 
If you want to discuss the game or provide feedback, feel free to join us on Discord ([url=https://discord.gg/M9pFptcA52][b]JOIN[/b][/url]).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45063531/a726346b4342c15a3e603f79c069a7ec8a4cde9b.png[/img]
We’ll continue to improve and update the game based on your input. Thanks again for your support!

notes.title: "Dice Player One" Launch on September 12!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

"Dice Player One" is set to be released on
[b]September 12th at 3 PM[/b]!

At the same time, we will remove "Dice Player One: Trailer" and adjust the content of the DEMO.
Thank you all once again for your support and companionship along the way!
🎲❤️🎲
